description.value: Napoletana Pizza Restaurant has been serving authentic Italian cuisine on Fraser Street in Vancouver since 2002, specializing in hand-stretched Neapolitan pizza and fresh pasta made daily. The warm, elegant dining room channels classic Italian hospitality and has become a well-established neighbourhood fixture over more than two decades. Cyclists on Fraser Street will find a full sit-down restaurant with both dine-in and takeout/delivery options.
